target.title: fix(agents): preserve completed post-tool replies
target.body:
Related: #94637
Closes #80918

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where an agent turn that completed after tool execution could return a stale pre-tool assistant snapshot, replacing the completed post-tool answer with an incomplete-turn error.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runner now chooses one canonical terminal assistant for the current attempt, falling back to the model-matched session assistant only when the attempt has none. Incomplete-turn classification, failover, result metadata, payloads, and stop reasons all consume that same value so they cannot disagree.

This is a maintainer takeover of #94637 because the contributor branch does not permit maintainer edits. Contributor credit is preserved with `Co-authored-by` and the changelog thanks @LiuwqGit.

## User Impact

Completed answers after tool calls are delivered as successful final replies instead of being replaced by stale incomplete-tool-use errors.

## Evidence

- Added a focused regression covering a stale pre-tool session snapshot followed by a completed current-attempt assistant.
- Fresh full-branch autoreview: clean; no accepted or actionable findings.
- Rebased on current `main` after the prior fork head's unrelated stale-base Control UI build failure.
- Exact-head hosted CI/Testbox will gate the replacement before merge.
